subject: Rivermark upcoming term / evaluation — migration risk & trial parameters
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@rivermark.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation window — short notice competitive test and timeline

Hi Jasmine / Laura,

We wanted to flag that Rivermark is being approached by a competitor promising a hardware-backed migration that could lower current inference spend by ~20% for our peak flows. Renewal is coming up in 6 weeks and the exec team has asked us to run a brief side-by-side evaluation focused on throughput and predictable latency under our 95th percentile.

We value the work we've done with Redwood, but we need a formal benchmark pack and a tight mutual action plan if we are to recommend sticking. Can you confirm you can run a targeted throughput benchmark against our baseline (attached) and commit to a 2-week technical trial window? Procurement will also need a clear SLA and evidence (SOC2 summary + audit logs retention policy).

Attached: rivermark-benchmark-request.pdf (baseline traces + QPS profile)

Thanks,
Alex Turner
CTO, Rivermark
alex.turner@rivermark.ai
---
Sent from my phone
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@rivermark.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation window — short notice competitive test and timeline

Alex — thanks for the heads up and for the baseline pack. We can run a targeted throughput validation and a short trial, but to make it useful we should align on:

- exact scenario (sequence lengths, burst pattern) — see page 3 of your PDF
- target metrics (95th latency, median, token cost)
- success gates for the trial and rollback criteria
- mutually-signed MAP (mutual action plan) with milestones and an owner for each item

We're attaching a draft mutual-action-plan and a one-page trial spec that maps your traces to the test harness we use. We can start the benchmark as early as Monday 10 May if we get a signed MAP and procurement requirements before end of day Friday.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (draft), redwood-trial-specs.xlsx

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick sync — 30 min on Thu to agree gates
2) We run an instrumented benchmark (2 business days)
3) 2-week trial if benchmark passes gates

I’ll loop in Marissa to discuss commercial flexibility if competitive pricing is in play.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0128
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@rivermark.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation window — short notice competitive test and timeline

Alex — appreciate the direct note. We’re committed to proving value here. A few commercial clarifications up front so procurement has sight:

- We can offer a time-limited trial credit to offset the trial cost, subject to a concurrent upsell commitment (minimum term uplift or committed capacity).
- For the benchmark and trial we ask that Rivermark provide a single test environment and representative traffic slice to avoid noisy signals.
- If the trial shows parity on cost but better predictability for our SLA you’d qualify for dedicated capacity pricing after renewal.

Jasmine — can you confirm the runbook we’ll use and whether we need to provision any temporary dedicated machines for the 2-week trial (that affects the pricing credit).

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Rivermark Procurement <procurement@rivermark.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@rivermark.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation window — short notice competitive test and timeline

Thanks — a few procurement asks before we sign the MAP:

1) SOC2 Type II report (summary OK) + attestation timeline
2) Clear SLA language with remedies and uptime target (we need 99.9% monthly uptime at minimum)
3) Data handling and logs retention policy during trial (who has access, retention period)
4) A redlineable term-sheet for the trial credit and the conditional upsell

We cannot proceed without SOC2 evidence and an explicit SLA, even for a trial. Also copying our legal counsel on the term-sheet once you provide a draft.

Procurement
Rivermark
procurement@rivermark.ai
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 08 May 2027 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Rivermark — temporary credit approval and escalation notes

Team — quick internal note following the Rivermark thread. Background: they face a credible replacement pitch emphasizing lower unit-cost on custom infra. Losing them at renewal would be a meaningful commercial gap.

Decision items:
- Approve a one-time trial credit up to $45k to cover the cost of the trial infrastructure and testing. This is contingent on a signed MAP and an upsell commitment: a 12-month capacity commit at a minimum uplift of 25% to their current committed spend.
- Marketing / Solutions: prioritize a streamlined benchmark runbook and dedicate a Solutions Engineer (Jasmine) + one infra engineer for the trial window (10–28 May).
- Legal: prepare a short-form SLA addendum and a SOC2 summary pack for procurement (we can provide the summary now; full report pending).

Karthik / Marissa — please confirm the credit mechanism (account credit vs invoice concession) and whether finance needs a deal memo. I’ll approve the deal memo if required.

Aditya Rao
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@rivermark.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rivermark Procurement <procurement@rivermark.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation window — short notice competitive test and timeline

Team — thanks for the quick engagement. We reviewed the draft MAP and the SOC2 summary; internal execs are willing to proceed under the following conditions:

1) Signed MAP received by EOD Friday (we attached a countersigned copy)
2) Trial window 10–24 May, with instrumented metrics sent daily
3) The trial credit as discussed will be reflected as a deduction on the first renewal invoice if we choose Redwood at renewal
4) Procurement needs the SLA addendum and logs retention statement before the trial start

We’ve attached the countersigned MAP (mutual-action-plan-signed.pdf). Please confirm SLA addendum and kickoff calendar invite. We’re booking a technical kickoff on Monday 10 May at 09:00 PT.

Looking forward — this trial will determine our recommendation at renewal.

Alex Turner
CTO, Rivermark
alex.turner@rivermark.ai
